keep_inline_images_in naming 'a' keeps an image inside a link that also holds a block element

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using HtmlToMarkdown;

var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert("<a href=\"https://example.com/file.pdf\"><img src=\"pdf.png\"><p>Download PDF</p></a>", new ConversionOptions { KeepInlineImagesIn = new List<string>() { "a" } });
Console.WriteLine(result.Content);
```
